title: Sağlık
canDo: Doktora ya da eczacıya şikayetlerimi anlatabilir, verilen talimatları anlayabilir ve başkalarına sağlıkla ilgili tavsiye verebilirim.
grammar: What's the matter? / I have a ... / My ... hurts

liveClass.title: Sağlık köşesi
liveClass.goal: Öğrenciler sırayla 'hasta' ve 'doktor' olur. Hasta bir şikayet kartı çeker ve belirtilerini anlatır; doktor sorular sorup should/shouldn't ile tavsiye verir. Sonunda sınıf, bir dergi için 'Sağlıklı yaşam için 10 tavsiye' listesi hazırlar.

lessons.title: Neren ağrıyor?
lessons.goal: Vücudumun ağrıyan yerini ve nasıl hissettiğimi anlatabilirim.

lines.speaker: Selin
lines.text: You don't look well, Arda. What's the matter?

lines.speaker: Arda
lines.text: I have a terrible headache, and my back hurts too.

lines.speaker: Selin
lines.text: Oh no. Is it because of the new chair?

lines.speaker: Arda
lines.text: Maybe. I sit at this desk for ten hours every day.

lines.speaker: Selin
lines.text: Do you feel dizzy?

lines.speaker: Arda
lines.text: A little. I think I need some fresh air.

questions.explanation: "I have a terrible headache, and my back hurts too."
"I think I need some fresh air."

learn.explanation:
**Sormak:**

- **What's the matter?** / **What's wrong?** (Neyin var?)
- **How do you feel?** / **Are you OK?**

**Ağrıları anlatmak — üç yol:**

| Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|
| I have a + ...ache | I have a **headache** / **stomach ache** / **toothache** / **backache** / **earache** |
| My + vücut bölümü + **hurts** | My **knee hurts**. / My **eyes hurt**. |
| I have a sore + ... | I have a **sore throat**. |

**Nasıl hissettiğini söylemek:** I feel **sick** / **dizzy** / **tired** / **terrible** / **better**.

İngiliz İngilizcesinde **I've got a headache** de çok yaygındır; anlamı aynıdır.

examples.en: My eyes hurt after a long day at the computer.
examples.tr: Uzun bir bilgisayar gününden sonra gözlerim ağrıyor.

examples.en: I have a sore throat and I feel tired.
What's the matter? – I feel sick.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "başım ağrıyor" deriz; İngilizcede "my head aches" çok az kullanılır, doğal olan "I have a headache" demektir. "I feel sick" Türkçedeki "hasta hissediyorum" değil, "midem bulanıyor" anlamındadır. Hasta olduğunuzu söylemek için "I'm ill" ya da "I'm not well" deyin.

lessons.title: Doktorda
lessons.goal: Doktora belirtilerimi anlatabilir ve sorularına cevap verebilirim.

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: Good morning. How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Leyla
lines.text: I feel terrible. I have a bad cough and a sore throat.

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: When did it start?

lines.speaker: Leyla
lines.text: Three days ago. And last night I had a high temperature.

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: Let me check. ... Yes, it's flu. Are you allergic to anything?

lines.speaker: Leyla
lines.text: No, I'm not.

lines.speaker: Doctor
lines.text: OK. Here's a prescription. You need to rest for a few days.

questions.prompt: What does the doctor say it is?

learn.explanation:
**Hastalıklar:**

| | |
|---|---|
| have **a cold** | soğuk algınlığı |
| have **flu** / **the flu** | grip |
| have **a temperature** / **a fever** | ateş |
| have **a cough** | öksürük |
| have **an allergy** / be **allergic to** ... | alerji |
| have **an infection** | enfeksiyon |

**Doktorun soruları:**

- How can I help you? / What seems to be the problem?
- **When did** it **start**? – Two days ago. / Yesterday.
- Are you **allergic to** anything? – Yes, I'm allergic to penicillin.
- Are you taking any medicine?

**Doktorun cevapları:** Let me check. / It's nothing serious. / Here's a prescription.

examples.en: I think I have a cold. I keep sneezing.
examples.tr: Sanırım soğuk algınlığım var. Sürekli hapşırıyorum.

examples.en: It's nothing serious. You'll be fine.

learn.turkishNote: "Ateşim var" = I have a temperature (fever). "Grip oldum" = I have flu / I've got the flu. "-e alerjim var" İngilizcede "allergic to" ile söylenir: I'm allergic to nuts (fındık/fıstığa). "keep + -ing" = sürekli ... -mek: I keep sneezing.

I keep ___. Maybe it's an allergy. (sneeze)

lessons.title: Tavsiye vermek
lessons.goal: should ve shouldn't ile birine tavsiye verebilirim.

discover.title: Dergi köşesi: Dr. Yasemin cevaplıyor
discover.body:
Dear Dr Yasemin,
I always feel tired, and I often have headaches. I work on a computer all day and I drink about six cups of coffee. What should I do?
— Tired Tolga

Dear Tolga,
You should take a short break every hour and look away from the screen. You shouldn't drink so much coffee. Two cups a day is enough. You should drink more water and go for a walk at lunchtime. And you should go to bed before midnight! If the headaches don't stop, you should see a doctor.
— Dr Yasemin

questions.prompt: How much coffee does Tolga drink?
What does Dr Yasemin say about coffee?
options: Two cups a day is enough

learn.explanation:
**should** + yalın fiil → tavsiye (bence yapman iyi olur)

**shouldn't** + yalın fiil → olumsuz tavsiye (bence yapmasan iyi olur)

- You **should** drink more water.
- You **shouldn't** eat so much sugar.
- He **should** see a doctor.

**can** gibi **should** de her özneyle aynıdır; -s, to veya do almaz:

- ~~He shoulds~~ / ~~You should to rest~~ / ~~You don't should~~

**Yumuşatmak:** I think you should... / I don't think you should... (I think you shouldn't yerine)

examples.en: You should go to bed early tonight.
You shouldn't lift heavy things with a bad back.
I don't think you should go to work today.

learn.turkishNote: should, Türkçedeki "-meli" ekine denk gelir ama bir emir değil, tavsiyedir: "You should rest" = Dinlenmelisin (bence). Zorunluluk için have to / must kullanılır (8. ünite). İngilizcede "I don't think you should" yapısı "I think you shouldn't"tan daha doğaldır.

lessons.title: Ne yapmalıyım?
lessons.goal: Tavsiye isteyebilir ve farklı yollarla öneride bulunabilirim.

lines.speaker: Onur
lines.text: I hurt my knee playing football yesterday. Should I go to the hospital?

lines.speaker: Ayşe
lines.text: Can you walk on it?

lines.speaker: Onur
lines.text: Yes, but it hurts a lot.

lines.speaker: Ayşe
lines.text: Why don't you put some ice on it first? And you shouldn't play football this week.

lines.speaker: Onur
lines.text: OK. Should I take a painkiller?

lines.speaker: Ayşe
lines.text: Yes, but if it doesn't get better in two days, you should definitely see a doctor.

questions.explanation: "Why don't you put some ice on it first?"

learn.explanation:
**Tavsiye istemek:**

- **Should I** + fiil? → Should I take a painkiller? – Yes, you **should**. / No, you **shouldn't**.
- **What should I** do?
- **Do you think I should** + fiil?

**Öneri sunmanın diğer yolları:**

| Kalıp | Örnek |
|---|---|
| Why don't you + fiil? | **Why don't you** put some ice on it? |
| Try + -ing | **Try drinking** some ginger tea. |
| If I were you, I'd + fiil | **If I were you, I'd** see a doctor. |

**Tavsiyeye cevap:** That's a good idea. / Thanks, I'll try that. / I don't think that's a good idea.

examples.en: Should I call the doctor? – Yes, I think you should.
examples.tr: Doktoru aramalı mıyım? – Evet, bence aramalısın.

examples.en: Why don't you take a day off?
If I were you, I'd stay at home.

learn.turkishNote: "Why don't you...?" şikayet gibi duyulsa da aslında arkadaşça bir öneridir: "Neden ... yapmıyorsun?" değil, "... yapsana" anlamında. "If I were you" bir kalıptır; I was değil I were denir. Bu yapının dilbilgisini B1'de göreceğiz.

lessons.title: Eczanede
lessons.goal: Eczacıdan ilaç isteyebilir ve kullanım talimatlarını anlayabilirim.

lines.speaker: Pharmacist
lines.text: Hello. Can I help you?

lines.speaker: Tourist
lines.text: Yes, please. I have a cold and a sore throat. Do you have anything for it?

lines.speaker: Pharmacist
lines.text: Try these tablets. Take two tablets three times a day, after meals.

lines.speaker: Tourist
lines.text: Can I take them with coffee?

lines.speaker: Pharmacist
lines.text: It's better with water. And you shouldn't drive. They can make you sleepy.

lines.speaker: Tourist
lines.text: OK, thank you. How much are they?

lines.speaker: Pharmacist
lines.text: Eighty-five lira. Get well soon!

questions.prompt: How often should the tourist take the tablets?

options: The tablets can make you sleepy.

learn.explanation:
**İlaç istemek:**

- Do you have anything **for** a headache / a cough?
- Can I have something **for** my stomach?
- Do I need a prescription?

**Talimatları anlamak:**

| İfade | Anlam |
|---|---|
| once / twice / three times a day | günde bir / iki / üç kez |
| before / after meals | yemeklerden önce / sonra |
| with water | su ile |
| on an empty stomach | aç karnına |
| every four hours | dört saatte bir |
| Don't take more than ... | ...'dan fazla almayın |

**Sağlıklı yaşam için:** eat healthily, get enough sleep, do exercise, drink plenty of water, avoid stress

examples.en: Do you have anything for a sore throat?
examples.tr: Boğaz ağrısı için bir şeyiniz var mı?

examples.en: Take one tablet every six hours.

learn.turkishNote: "Günde iki kez" = twice a day (two times a day da anlaşılır ama twice daha doğaldır). "Baş ağrısı için" = for a headache (against değil). "İlaç içmek" İngilizcede take medicine'dir: drink medicine sadece şurup için kullanılabilir.

options: Do you have anything against a headache?
Do you have anything for a headache?
